name: SceneLightUIHook
src_typeComment: Drop ANYWHERE in the scene (once) to publish the scene's main Directional Light's direction as a GLOBAL shader value, which Toolkit/UI/Lighting Effects' Scene Light mode reads to fake-light UI elements as if they were flat cards facing the camera. Without this, Scene Light mode's light direction defaults to zero, which reads as flat/shadowed everywhere — not an error, just nothing to react to.

src_serialized.name: directionalLight
src_serialized.tooltip: Leave empty to auto-find the first enabled Directional Light in the scene.

src_serialized.name: updateEveryFrame
src_serialized.tooltip: Turn off if the light never rotates at runtime, to skip needless per-frame work.

src_members.name: PublishDirection
src_members.comment: Public so a self-test (or a script that just changed which light is assigned) can push an update without waiting for the next Update tick.
